name: INTERNAL-SEND — one new email from Aditya's mailbox to Sidana team addresses only (webhook, dry-run first)

parameters.jsCode: const b = $('Build').first().json; const r = $input.first().json; return [{ json: { to: b.to, cc: b.cc, subject: b.subject, sent_id: r.id || '', thread: r.threadId || '' } }];
